title: Wes touring as the Wynton Kelly Trio featuring Wes
summary: Wes with Kelly, Chambers and Cobb was uneasy about being billed as a star.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: He sure did. Those hits were coming up, and then he went on, he came out on tour, out to California. And he had Wynton Kelly and Paul Chambers and Jimmy Cobb. Miles's rhythm section was working with him. But they first sent him out on tour as The Wynton Kelly Trio featuring Wes Montgomery. So the trio would come out and play, and then Wes came out like a singer would. He didn't come out to open the set up, and it made him very uncomfortable, because he just couldn't adjust to being a star.
